changelog: v1.0.8: push-backbone probe. GcmService is an on-demand service — 'not running' is normal on an idle device and was a misleading health signal inherited from the original Guardian. The status card now shows the real backbone: the com.google.android.gms.persistent process (pidof with ps -A fallback), which hosts the MCS long connection to mtalk.google.com:5228. JSON gains gcm_persistent; the human GMS line shows gcm=on-demand|persist=yes/no|recv=N; old reports without the field render as neutral '未知(旧报告)'. Also note for CN users: FCM's MCS endpoint is blocked by the GFW — GMS traffic must be covered by your proxy for the long connection to establish at all; that is outside any module's reach. v1.0.7: self-healing targets + device-truth [diag] lines (toybox grep -E does not support \s — root cause of the silent no-op loop, fixed via POSIX [[:space:]]). v1.0.6: probe-truth hardening. v1.0.5: one-tap diagnostic log copy. v1.0.4: friendly guidance UX. v1.0.3: dead-bridge read-only mode. v1.0.2: universal bridge adapter. v1.0.1: absolute moduleDir paths. v1.0.0: initial release — GMS stopped-state detection & unstop (Android 13+), triple GCM heartbeat, per-boot one-shot auto recovery, target manager, vivo deep links, offline WebUI. Requires Full access + Allow background actions, shell uid 2000 only.
